scientific_scope: same real OPS-SAT source, fixed MSF max64, repeated group-disjoint internal perturbation study; exploratory not blind verification
frozen_rule: MSF max64 (engineering selection), C=0.5 balanced logistic; same dimensions chosen fit-only for all arms within fold

blocked_group.definition: sort original train segments within each telemetry channel by segment ID; group consecutive 16 same-channel segments. Segment ID ordering is only an order proxy, not independently verified UTC chronology.

partition.second_split: new simulated labeled batch 36% of reserved groups, remainder for calibration, gate, audit
partition.third_split: alarm threshold and baseline label-conflict calibration 33% of remaining groups, remaining gate+audit
partition.fourth_split: independent candidate acceptance 50% of remaining groups, remaining audit

blocked_group.if_infeasible: record as infeasible for that preregistered seed (no replacement based on model performance)

channel_shift.design: hold out all target channel records from old fit. Target channel: earliest 50% segments to simulated label upload, next 25% to acceptance, last 25% to descriptive audit; non-target channels split fit/calibration by group to avoid same-group leakage.
channel_shift.purpose: sensitivity to changed channel with correct labels (legitimate operating/domain change), not to claim new sensor distribution transfer learning

existing_label_source: Original true OPS-SAT published anomaly labels repackaged as hypothetical operator update. All deliberately flipped labels are faults injected into copies.

public_baselines.A: old model only, threshold fitted calibration-only
public_baselines.B: usual supervised retrain old+label batch, threshold fitted calibration-only
public_baselines.C: ordinary non-inferiority validation gate on F1/AP/recall/FPR
public_baselines.D: C plus strict non-inferiority on Brier/NLL
public_baselines.E: calibration-only best simple convex old/new probability shrinkage, acceptance after D gate

required_public_stats_for_private_frozen: sample counts for each fold and split
old probability high-confidence conflict counts on clean calibration (reference) and each hypothetical batch
A/B acceptance and audit F1, AP, Recall, FPR, Brier, NLL for 4 label conditions
A/B threshold selection on calibration only
per-fold feature count, search time, fit time, prior audit only descriptive
private_candidate: not embedded in public workflow; use unchanged v0.2 implementation separately on public pre-update evidence
boundary_conditions: Previously viewed official test and many internal audit splits prevent a confirmatory blind claim
Channel/group held-out data are still drawn from same spacecraft dataset
Time ordering is a segment-ID proxy, not guaranteed actual physical UTC telemetry order
A high old-model conflict with a legitimate changed channel must not be equated to wrong expert labels
No real new authenticated label reviewer, no true three-state fault label, no dynamic HMM ground truth from this dataset
Compare correct candidate update accept rate AND corrupt candidate reject rate, not only accuracy of abstention
No patent-sensitive details in this repository; ordinary controls only
No changes to main or frozen delivery branch
